description: Experimental bounded document agent. Supply an objective and 1 to 8 plain-text documents (24000 characters total). The local model can search and read only these documents, with up to five tool calls, then return an answer and source quotes. No web browsing, host file access or code execution. Citation matching is checked, factual accuracy is not guaranteed. Shares chat/image trial quotas. Poll get_studio_job. No external AI fallback.
name: submit_agent_job
title: Delegate a document task
